cases.text: the temperature at ac is what

ld.evidence: The request asks for a temperature, which can be a factual query; the meaning of "ac" is unclear.

llm.evidence: If "ac" means air conditioning, the temperature concerns an appliance. The abbreviation is not expanded.

cases.boundary_note: Unexpanded abbreviations can leave temperature queries between general information, local weather, and appliance status.

cases.text: what is up with my account, why is it blocked

llm.evidence: A blocked account can concern banking, but the request does not identify the account as financial.

ld.evidence: The account type is unspecified, so the text does not establish a supplied subject category.

cases.boundary_note: Account-access complaints need context to distinguish financial accounts from other service accounts.

cases.text: how is ford's stock doing

llm.evidence: Stock performance concerns financial values, which Money & Banking explicitly includes.

ld.evidence: This is a factual question, but its specific subject is financial performance.

cases.boundary_note: A factual question about financial values fits the financial subject more specifically than general knowledge.

cases.text: when was my car last in the shop

ld.evidence: Asking when a car was last in the shop concerns vehicle service history.

llm.evidence: Vehicle service history is explicitly included in Cars & Vehicle Care.

cases.boundary_note: Questions about past vehicle maintenance belong with vehicle care even when phrased as date retrieval.

cases.text: ai, refer to me as deb when answering me

ld.evidence: The request sets how the assistant should address the user, which the catalog explicitly covers.

llm.evidence: The user asks the assistant to use a preferred name when answering.

cases.boundary_note: Preferred forms of address are assistant response preferences.

cases.text: what were you supposed to remind me of

ld.evidence: Addressing the assistant does not change the subject: the request asks about an existing reminder.

llm.evidence: The user asks to retrieve a reminder, and reminders are explicitly included here.

cases.boundary_note: Requests to retrieve reminders belong with reminder management despite conversational wording.

cases.text: help, i've lost my cellphone!

llm.evidence: The request concerns a lost cellphone, and locating devices is explicitly included.

ld.evidence: The catalog supplies a category for locating devices, matching the lost-cellphone request.

cases.boundary_note: Help finding a personal device fits device interaction without an explicit locate command.

cases.text: what company designed this

ld.evidence: The request asks for a designer company, which can be a factual identification question. The referent of "this" is missing.

llm.evidence: Assistant background fits if "this" refers to the assistant, but the text does not establish that referent.

cases.boundary_note: Unresolved demonstratives can prevent distinguishing assistant provenance from general factual identification.

cases.text: text katy and tell her i love her

ld.evidence: Sending a text to a named person fits the supplied communication subject.

llm.evidence: The user requests a direct interpersonal message to Katy.

cases.boundary_note: Direct interpersonal messages fit communication even when the listed examples emphasize phone calls.

cases.text: will using a discover card in rome cause transaction fees

ld.evidence: The question concerns credit-card transaction fees, explicitly within Money & Banking.

llm.evidence: The subject is a credit-card fee; the overseas location supplies context.

cases.boundary_note: A travel location does not displace the financial subject of a card-fee question.

cases.text: can you call the help desk line for my credit card company

llm.evidence: The user asks the assistant to place a phone call, an explicitly included action.

ld.evidence: The recipient is a credit-card company, providing a banking context, but the requested action is a call.

cases.boundary_note: Calling a financial service overlaps communication and banking; an explicit call request favors communication.

cases.text: is it possible to reserve a table at white castle

llm.evidence: The request asks about reserving a restaurant table, explicitly covered by Food & Dining.

ld.evidence: Restaurant reservation availability falls within Food & Dining.

cases.boundary_note: Questions about restaurant reservation availability share the dining subject with making reservations.

cases.text: i need to call my coworker

ld.evidence: The user wants to call another person, and making phone calls is explicitly included.

llm.evidence: Calling a coworker is interpersonal communication.

cases.boundary_note: The relationship to the recipient does not change a simple phone-call request into an employee-benefits question.

cases.text: what stores are in the local mall

llm.evidence: The request seeks the stores available at a shopping location, fitting the shopping subject.

ld.evidence: The wording is a factual question, but its practical subject is shopping venues.

cases.boundary_note: Information about shopping venues fits shopping more specifically than a general factual-question category.
